topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I understand the need for privacy, really I do, but this fence—it just seems so...permanent. We've always had an open space, a shared pathway where our kids play and our dogs roam. Now, it's like drawing a line, setting boundaries. I've tried talking to my neighbor, explaining how it feels, but it's like talking to a wall. I know I should be reasonable, but every time I think about it, it's like my throat tightens. I don't want to lose the easy, friendly relationship we've always had. I just wish there was another way, something that could keep us connected, not divided.
